primo: primo — cousin (masc. sg.; primo eres de mis fijas 'you are cousin to my daughters'; = primo)
mándot: mandar + te — I order you (present 1st sg. + enclitic te, e dropped; mándot que vayas 'I order you to go'; = te mando)
vayas: ir — you go, may you go (present subjunctive 2nd sg.; mándot que vayas 'I bid you go'; = vayas)
verás: veer — you will see (future 2nd sg.; = verás)
dadas: dar — given (past participle fem. pl., agreeing with heredades; a mis fijas dadas son 'are given to my daughters'; = dadas)
vernás: venir — you will come (future 2nd sg., syncopated, with -r- for -dr-; = vendrás)
tornémosnos: tornar + nos — let us go back (present subjunctive 1st pl., hortative, with reflexive nos kept after the full -mos ending; = volvámonos)
veder: veer — to see (infinitive, the old full form, its de restored by Pidal in italics, ve[de]r; ir las hemos veder 'we will go to see them'; = ver)
acomendamos: acomendar — we entrust, commend (present 1st pl.; = encomendamos)
atales: atal — such (pl.; a- + tal; atales cosas 'such things'; = tales)
respondien: responder — they answered (imperfect 3rd pl., -ién ending; = respondían)
departiçión: departiçión — parting, separation (fem.; a la departiçión 'at the parting'; = despedida, separación)
lloran: llorar — they weep (present 3rd pl.; lloran de coraçón 'they weep from the heart'; = lloran)
fazían: fazer — they did, acted (imperfect 3rd pl.; assí fazían 'so did, likewise'; = hacían)
oyas: oír — hear! (present subjunctive 2nd sg. used as an exhortation, probably; Oyas, sobrino 'Listen, nephew'; = oigas, in sense 'oye')
iredes: ir — you will go (future 2nd pl., old -edes ending; = iréis)
yazredes: yazer — you will lie, lodge (future 2nd pl., syncopated yazr- for yazer-, old -edes; i yazredes una noch 'you will spend one night there'; = yaceréis)
saludad: saludar — greet (imperative 2nd pl., d kept; saludad a mio amigo 'give my greetings to my friend'; = saludad)
reciba: recebir — let him receive (present subjunctive 3rd sg., jussive; reciba a mios yernos 'let him welcome my sons-in-law'; = reciba)
pudier: poder — he can, may be able (future subjunctive 3rd sg., final -e dropped; commo ell pudier mejor 'as best he can'; = pudiere)
dil: dezir + le — tell him (imperative 2nd sg. di + enclitic le, e dropped; = dile)
ovieren: aver — they may have (future subjunctive 3rd pl.; de lo que ovieren huebos 'of what they may have need'; = hubieren)
sírvalas: servir + las — let him serve them (present subjunctive 3rd sg., jussive, + enclitic las; = sírvalas)
escúrralas: escurrir + las — let him escort them, see them on their way (present subjunctive 3rd sg., jussive, + enclitic las; no modern verb of this sense; = que las acompañe)
fiziere: fazer — he may do (future subjunctive 3rd sg.; de quanto él fiziere 'for all he does'; = hiciere)
yol: yo + le — I (to) him (subject yo + enclitic dative le, e dropped; yol daré 'I shall give him'; = yo le)
partidos: partir — parted, separated (past participle masc. pl., with son 'they are parted'; = partidos)
nasçió: nasçer — he was born (preterite 3rd sg.; en buen ora nasçió, part of the poem's birth-formula 'born in a good hour'; = nació)
alvarrazín: Alvarrazín — Albarracín (Teruel), named for the Muslim family of the Aben Razín who held it (Pidal, note to v. 1462); Santa María d'Alvarrazín, the Infantes' halt on the road from Valencia towards Molina (= Albarracín)
félos: fe + los — behold them (fe an interjection of presentation, + enclitic los; félos en Molina 'there they are at Molina'; = helos aquí / ahí los tenéis)
recebir: recebir — to receive, welcome (infinitive; saliólos recebir 'went out to welcome them'; = recibir)
avorozes: avoroz — rejoicing, festivity (masc. pl. avorozes; Pidal 'alborozos, regocijos'; con grandes avorozes 'with great rejoicing'; = alborozos)
sirvió: servir — he served, treated well (preterite 3rd sg.; bien los sirvió 'he served them well'; = sirvió)
escurrir: escurrir — to escort, see off (infinitive; escurrir los mandó 'he ordered (them) to escort'; no modern verb of this sense; = acompañar)
luzón: Luzón — Luzón, a village of the province of Guadalajara between Medinaceli and Molina (Pidal, note to v. 1491); los montes de Luzón, the 'wild and high mountains' of v. 1491, crossed on the road between Molina and the Jalón (= Luzón)
anssarera: Anssarera — a place unknown today, which must have lain between Medinaceli and the river Jalón (Pidal, el Ansarera); where the party lodged after crossing Arbuxuelo (el Anssarera, with the article)
posados: posar — lodged, encamped (past participle masc. pl., with son; ellos posados son 'they are lodged'; = posados, alojados)
vedien: veer — they were seeing, saw (imperfect 3rd pl., -ié ending, with the old -d- restored in ve[d]ien; = veían)
entramos: entramos — both (masc. pl., from Latin inter ambos; entramos hermanos 'both brothers'; = entrambos, ambos)
pudiéssemos: poder — we could (imperfect subjunctive 1st pl., in a conditional clause; si pudiéssemos matar 'if we could kill'; = pudiésemos)
quanta: quanto — as much as, all that (fem. sg., agreeing with riquiza; quanta riquiza tiene 'all the wealth he has'; = cuanta)
yemos: aver — would (conditional ending -iemos, 1st pl., written apart after the infinitive and a pronoun in a split conditional; aver la yemos 'we would have it'; = la habríamos; -iemos = -íamos)
latinado: latinado — one who knows 'Latin', i.e. the Romance tongue of the Christians (adjective used as noun; Pidal 'ladino, que sabe la lengua romance'; moro latinado 'a Romance-speaking Moor'; = ladino)
entendió: entender — he understood (preterite 3rd sg., here 'overheard, took in'; gelo entendió 'understood it'; = entendió)
díxolo: dezir + lo — he said it, told it (strong preterite 3rd sg. + enclitic lo; = lo dijo)
acáyaz: acáyaz — governor, commander of a fortress (Pidal 'alcaide', the same as alcáyaz, v. 1502; = alcaide)
cúriate: curiar + te — guard yourself, beware (imperative 2nd sg. + enclitic te; cúriate destos 'beware of these men'; = cuídate)
odi: oír — I heard (preterite 1st sg., with the old -d- restored in o[d]i; = oí)
conssejar: conssejar — to counsel, plot (infinitive, ss spelling; tu muert odi conssejar 'I heard (them) plotting your death'; = aconsejar; tramar)
barragán: barragán — brave young man, stout fellow, warrior (masc. sg.; Pidal 'buen mozo', 'esforzado'; mucho era buen barragán 'was a right valiant man'; = barragán)
parós: parar + se — he stopped, took his stand (preterite 3rd sg. paró + reflexive se; parós ante los ifantes 'he halted before the Infantes'; = se paró)
dexás: dexar — (if) I left alone, held back (imperfect subjunctive 1st sg., dexasse with the final -e dropped, as desenparás v. 1471, probably; si no lo dexás por mio Çid 'if I did not hold back for my Çid's sake'; = dejase)
faría: fazer — I would do (conditional 1st sg.; tal cosa vos faría 'I would do you such a thing'; = haría)
sonás: sonar — it should resound, be talked of (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg., sonasse with the final -e dropped, as dexás, probably; que por el mundo sonás 'that it would resound through the world'; = sonase)
levaría: levar — I would carry off, take (conditional 1st sg.; levaría sus fijas al Campeador 'I would take his daughters back to the Campeador'; = llevaría)
entrariedes: entrar — you would enter (conditional 2nd pl., -iedes ending; = entraríais)
jamás: jamás — ever; nunqua … jamás 'never ever, never again' (= jamás)

__broaden__.fed: fe — pledged faith, troth (Pidal's restored older form of fe) · also fer (fazer) — do! (imperative 2nd pl. of the short verb fer; atales cosas fed 'do such things'; = haced)
__broaden__.aver: aver — wealth, property, goods (noun use of aver, beside aver the verb 'to have') · also aver — to have (infinitive; aver … de + inf. 'to be bound to', split conditional aver vos lo iedes de far 'you would be bound to do it') · also aver as the first half of a split conditional (aver la yemos 'we would have it'; = la habríamos)
__broaden__.avemos: aver — we have (present 1st pl.; = hemos) · avemos de + inf. 'we must' (mucho avemos de andar 'we have far to go'); avemos qué fablar 'we have something to speak of' · also perfect auxiliary aver + participle (avemos preso 'we have taken') · also avemos a + inf. 'we are to' (a dexar avemos 'we are to leave')
__broaden__.que: que — that, who, which; for · also por que — because, since (= porque) · por que — by which, whereby (por que más valdrá 'whereby he will be worth more') · also que — 'so that, lest' introducing purpose/result (que por miedo non dexen nada; por tal lo faze … que no lo ventasse nadi); after después/mientra 'after, while' (después que, mientra que) · also que — than, after a comparative (mas le vienen … que nos le van 'more come to him than leave him') · also que — what (indirect interrogative; dezir vos he que faze 'I shall tell you what he does'; = qué) · also que — how, exclamative before an adverb (Dios, que bien los sirvió! 'God, how well he served them!'; = qué)
__broaden__.tal: tal — such; por tal 'for such a reason, for this purpose' (= tal) · also tal … commo — 'such … as' (tal juego commo iva por la cort 'such sport as went round the court') · also tal … que — 'such … that' of result (tal cosa vos faría que por el mundo sonás 'I would do you such a thing that it would resound through the world')
__broaden__.paró: parar — he agreed, arranged (preterite 3rd sg.; Pidal: 'convino, concertó'; las vistas que con el rey paró 'the meeting he arranged with the king'; = acordó, concertó) · also pararse — to halt, take one's stand (ante mio Çid se paró 'drew up before my Çid'; = se detuvo, se plantó)
__broaden__.troçir: troçir — to pass, elapse (infinitive; no modern equivalent, closest transcurrir) · also troçir — to cross, pass over a place (ivan troçir los montes 'they were going to cross the mountains'; Pidal 'iban a atravesar'; = atravesar)
__broaden__.conssejaron: consejar — they took counsel, they advised (preterite 3rd pl., ss spelling; reflexive se conssejaron 'they took counsel together'; = aconsejaron, se aconsejaron) · also conssejar — to plot, scheme (conssejaron traçión 'they plotted treachery'; Pidal 'maquinaron traición'; = tramaron)
